Accessibility

One Link is for every body.

This statement records current intentions and known gaps. It is manually reviewed; it is not a claim of continuous update, complete testing, or full WCAG conformance.

Standard we target

Accessibility design targets and known evidence gaps.

We aim for full Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1 Level AA conformance on every page of this site. The same standard the EU Accessibility Act 2025, the UK Equality Act, and US Section 508 reference.

What we still have to fix

Honest list.

No site is fully accessible. Here is what we know is imperfect today, what we are working on, and what is intentional.

WebGPU coherence field

Design target, not a universal verified guarantee. This repository does not publish a complete route, browser, assistive-technology, contrast, motion, and touch test matrix proving this item across every surface.

QR scanning

The current website self-test runs both pairing roles in one tab and displays a QR generated by the production primitive. It does not open the camera, scan a phone or second device, test transport, or complete real two-device pairing; the SAS can be copied for accessibility review only.

Audio cues

Design target, not a universal verified guarantee. This repository does not publish a complete route, browser, assistive-technology, contrast, motion, and touch test matrix proving this item across every surface.

Tell us when we miss

Let us know.

If anything on this site or in One Link is not accessible to you, we want to hear. Email weareone@oneunity.earth with the page and what broke. We aim to acknowledge within five days and fix as quickly as we can.
